Designed for urban explorations and outdoor adventures, the style comes with a detachable handle so that it can also be worn slung over the shoulder. The combination of Re-Nylon and leather expresses the dualism of the design that combines technical details and refined notes. For sustainable care to preserve the product's characteristics and reduce microfiber shedding, we recommend not washing the item too often. Let the product air out after every use and have it dry cleaned at a specialized ecological dry cleaners.
details: Adjustable woven nylon tape shoulder straps
Enameled metal triangle logo on the flap
Closure with drawstring, flap and side-release buckle system
Three external pockets with zipper and flap with side-release buckle system
Interior with zipper pocket and patch pocket

products.title: Re-Nylon and Saffiano leather backpack
products.description: The evolution of an iconic Prada style since the eighties, this nylon backpack is made of Re-Nylon, a regenerated yarn produced from recycled, purified plastic trash collected in the ocean, fishing nets, and textile waste fibers. This technologically innovative fabric is paired with Saffiano leather, an historic material of Prada tradition defined by its crosshatch pattern and waxed finish. The enameled metal triangle logo accents the compact design with flap and oversized front pocket. For sustainable care to preserve the product's characteristics and reduce microfiber shedding, we recommend not washing the item too often. Let the product air out after every use and have it dry cleaned at a specialized ecological dry cleaners.
details: Enameled metal triangle logo on flap
Interior with zipper pocket and patch pocket
